properties/log_id: Retained command log ID to read. Omit to list available logs, optionally filtered by step_id and call_id.
properties/step_id: One-based history step filter when listing logs. Use with call_id to identify one invocation's retained output.
properties/call_id: Tool-call ID filter when listing logs; pair with step_id because call IDs are unique within a step.
properties/stream: Retained stream to read with log_id: stdout (default) or stderr.
properties/offset: UTF-8 byte offset for stream pages; record index when listing logs. Use a supplied next_offset for a needed additional page.
properties/limit: Characters per stream read (default and maximum 32,000,000); number of records when listing logs.
properties/tail: With log_id, return the last limit characters, ignoring offset.
